# JobMatch

A personal job-search app. Flask + a 1,173-board scrape pipeline across 29 applicant-tracking
systems + an offline résumé grader + a Chrome extension that fills application forms. ~23,000
jobs, three scrape runs a weekday. Live at **stemjobs1.astrochakra.co** on shared cPanel.

<!-- HERO: docs/img/surfaces.svg goes here (generated by scripts/build_docs.py) -->

## Three things that will cost you an afternoon if you don't read them

> ⚠ **`git push` does not deploy.** Deploying is a zip: `python scripts/build_deploy_zip.py` →
> cPanel File Manager → Upload → Extract → `touch tmp/restart.txt`. `.cpanel.yml` exists and never
> runs, because cPanel only executes it for a repo hosted on cPanel. → [docs/OPERATIONS.md](docs/OPERATIONS.md)

> ⚠ **The feed filter exists three times** and all three must agree: `web.py::_filter_rows`
> (server), `static/app.js::matches()` (client), `core.py::prefs_match` (email digest).
> `scripts/feed_parity.py` is the only thing keeping them in step. → [docs/INDEX.md](docs/INDEX.md)

> ⚠ **`idf.json` is source-of-truth, not a cache.** A partial rebuild silently re-weights every
> match score in the corpus. → [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)

## I have a problem in…

| …this area | Start here |
|---|---|
| a page renders wrong, a route 404s | `web.py` — 82 routes, no blueprints → [docs/MAP.md](docs/MAP.md) |
| a job is missing from the feed | the intake funnel → [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) |
| a board suddenly returns nothing | the ATS adapters in `scraper/__init__.py` → [docs/MAP.md](docs/MAP.md) |
| match scores look wrong | `core.py` scoring cluster + `scraper/score_jobs.py` |
| the résumé grader or Resume Brain | `resume_score.py`, `resume_brain/` |
| "the database isn't saving" | `db.py::_LazyHTTP` transport dispatch → [docs/INDEX.md](docs/INDEX.md) |

Full symptom → file:line lookup: **[docs/INDEX.md](docs/INDEX.md)**.

## Getting started

```bash
python web.py
```

Serves on :5000. Tests: `python scripts/run_tests.py`. See
[docs/OPERATIONS.md](docs/OPERATIONS.md) for environment variables, the schedule, and how to add a
board or a user.

`app.py` is the retired Streamlit UI — it still boots, which is the trap. Nothing imports it.
